name: Mornington Main Street Market
signature: The northern Peninsula's midweek town market, a broad mix that folds easily into a Mornington visit.
editorNote: Mornington Main Street Market is held each Wednesday on Main Street. Browse the stalls as part of a Mornington town day; check the organiser for this week’s hours and any changes before travelling.
